questions.question: Why did referee José María Sánchez Martínez abandon the La Liga match between Rayo Vallecano and Athletic Bilbao?
options: Severe weather flooded the pitch and made play hazardous
A power failure disabled the floodlights and VAR system
Supporters invaded the pitch following a disputed penalty decision
Spectators threw objects onto the pitch in protest against Rayo's club president
questions.explanation: The fixture was halted because supporters hurled projectiles onto the pitch during a protest against Rayo Vallecano president Raúl Martín Presa.
questions.context: 2026–27 La Liga: In association football, the match between Rayo Vallecano and Athletic Bilbao is abandoned by referee José María Sánchez Martínez due to fans throwing objects at the pitch to protest against Rayo president Raúl Martín Presa.

questions.question: Which politician was chosen as the Socialist Party candidate for the 2027 French presidential race after winning over 66% of the primary vote?
questions.explanation: Raphaël Glucksmann achieved victory in the first round of the Socialist Party primary, securing more than 66% of ballots to become their presidential nominee.
questions.context: 2027 French presidential election: Raphaël Glucksmann is elected as a candidate in the 2027 presidential election during the Socialist Party primary, receiving more than 66% of the votes in the first round.

questions.question: Eight orangutans saved from wildfires were returned to protected habitat in which Indonesian province?
questions.explanation: International Animal Rescue and the Indonesian forestry ministry released the eight rescued primates into a protected forest located in West Kalimantan.
questions.context: 2026 Indonesia wildfires: The Indonesian forestry ministry and International Animal Rescue release eight orangutans rescued from wildfires into a protected wildforest in West Kalimantan after fires destroyed habitat near plantations.

questions.question: In Chile, where did a passenger bus crash into a housing complex after hurtling down a slope?
questions.explanation: The deadly crash occurred when a bus travelled down an incline and collided with residential buildings in the city of Valparaíso.
questions.context: One person is killed and around 19 others are injured, including four critically, when a passenger bus plunges down a slope and crashes into a residential complex in Valparaíso, Chile.

questions.question: Near which Omani city was the commercial tanker MT Petro Dolphin targeted by an unmanned drone?
questions.explanation: The MT Petro Dolphin was hit by a drone in waters near Sohar, prompting Omani emergency teams to search for missing crew.
questions.context: Middle Eastern crisis > 2026 Iran war > 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis: A drone strikes the tanker MT Petro Dolphin near Sohar, Oman, leaving two Indian sailors missing and prompting the rescue of nine others. Omani authorities conduct search-and-rescue operations for the missing crew members.
